Information.Description: Testosterone is an androstanoid having 17beta-hydroxy and 3-oxo groups, together with unsaturation at C-4C-5.. It has a role as an androgen, a mouse metabolite, a human metabolite and a Daphnia magna metabolite. It is a C19-steroid, a 17beta-hydroxy steroid, a 3-oxo-Delta(4) steroid and an androstanoid.
